correctness.rationale: In nonplane rooted PDA leaf-labeled trees the specified fringe topology on k marked leaves contracts bijectively to a tree on n-k+1 leaves; disjoint marked patterns contract twice. Laminarity exhausts cherry/four-fringe overlaps: balanced four-fringes contain two cherries, asymmetric four-fringes one. First moments and disjoint contributions give both rational expressions for all n≥6; n=4,5 require d_n=0 and direct substitution. At n=4 apparent negative 2n−9 denominator is handled correctly. The quadratic sign factors are strictly positive n≥5, and independent exact-Fraction contractions n=4..15 reproduce formulas. Ratio monotonicity follows from stated positive finite difference, not finite testing.
residual_risks: No formal theorem prover certification; bounded finite checks not all-size proofs.
